is_anopheles.evidence: Mentions Anopheles funestus and Anopheles gambiae s.l. entomological surveillance and resistance assay data in the study area (page 3-4).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study is an epidemiological cohort study evaluating malaria incidence in children. It does not genotype any insecticide-resistance markers; it only refers to previous work in the first cohort reporting 'no evidence of target site mutation in kdr' (page 4).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No mosquito genotype data or allele frequencies are reported in the paper.

african_field_population.evidence: Entomologic surveillance data discussed refers to field populations from Machinga District, Malawi (page 3-4).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary epidemiologic cohort study of children in Malawi (page 1-3).

sub_country_location.evidence: Traditional Authority of Sitola, Machinga District, Malawi (page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Cohort followed from May to December 2013 (page 1, 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study does not present new entomological marker data.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary mosquito genotype datasets are mentioned or needed.

assessment.summary: This is an epidemiological cohort study investigating the effectiveness of 1- to 2-year-old ITNs against malaria infection in children in Machinga District, Malawi. No mosquito genotyping was performed or reported.
exclusion_reasons: No target insecticide resistance markers were genotyped in this study.
No extractable mosquito genotype data are presented.
